messages:
Hiro T: FYI: CS flagged a tenant where invoice-preview showed a 20% discount on embeddings but final invoice removed the discount. seen this before?
Maya P: that's new to me. any sample tenant/event?
Hiro T: tenant id tn-889, preview run pr-2026-06-05-11. preview line: "embeddings: -20% partner-discount" final had normal rate.
Ethan G: could be discount attribution lost in the event enrichment path. previews are generated at the edge using promo headers; later pipeline joins promo metadata via route_resolution id. if those don't align, discount gets dropped.
Nora S: we recently changed reserved-capacity routing to prefer dedicated pools which rewrites route_meta for cost optimization. maybe that rewrite drops promo_token header.
Hiro T: exact case: edge sent header X-Promo-Token: promo-42, then fallback to dedicated pool rewrote route_meta and proxy didn't forward X-Promo-Token. preview used X-Promo-Token; ingest lost it.
Maya P: that's bad because preview promises a discount CS communicates. short-term: show a "discount provisional" badge on preview when promo header exists on edge but invoice lacks discount provenance match. long-term: ensure promo provenance is part of canonical route metadata (route_provenance) so it's preserved through rewrites.
Ethan G: two implementation options: (A) copy X-Promo-Token into canonical metadata at the edge before any rewrite (idempotent header), or (B) emit a separate provenance field in the billing event: provenance: [edge_promo=promo-42, ingest_promo=null] so we can detect mismatch and surface it.
Nora S: (A) is simpler but requires every proxy path to honor that header across rewrites. (B) is more explicit for auditing but needs schema changes in the metering event (and console changes).
Hiro T: telemetry concern: adding provenance array increases event size and cardinality for logs. can we limit to 'promo_present' boolean + promo_id only for canary tenants?
Maya P: for visibility we need promo_id in plaintext (hashed if sensitive). but we can gate full provenance for canary tenants and emit a lighter metric promo_mismatch_count for all tenants.
Ethan G: agree. I'll prototype (A) first: edge sets header X-Promo-Stable and we teach proxy rewrite to preserve it. I'll add tests covering retry/rewrite. ETA ~1 day.
Nora S: I'll update the canonical metadata schema to include promo_stable as an optional field and ensure ingest picks it up before dedupe/route-resolution. ETA 2 days.
Maya P: Console UX: I'll add a hoverable note on preview line: "Discount shown based on promo token received at edge. If routing changes, discount may be re-evaluated at invoice time" and an inline link to runbook. Also add a small red dot if promo_mismatch detected. ETA 6h.
Hiro T: billing-bot: kicked a synthetic replay to simulate proxy rewrite without header copying.
billing-bot: synthetic run 7923456990: 3 tenants, pre-fix promo_mismatch=3, post-simulated-preserve=0. link: https://internal/ci/7923456990
Maya P: good signal. Ethan, can you add a new metric promo_mismatch_rate and alert if >0.05% non-canary tenants in 1h? Also add a dashboard card showing top promo ids with mismatch counts for quicker triage.
Ethan G: will add metric + dashboard tile. I'll namespace it under billing.provenance.promo_mismatch.
Nora S: note for rollout: enable X-Promo-Stable for a tenant canary list first. we should coordinate with sales/CS so they don't rely on previews during canary.
Hiro T: agreed. I'll message CS and sales with the canary list and a short FAQ.
Maya P: final check: ensure promo header copying doesn't accidentally re-enable promos for tenants that have per-tenant promo disable flag. Edge should respect tenant-level overrides.
Ethan G: good catch. middleware will check tenant config before setting X-Promo-Stable.
Hiro T: thanks all. logging follow-up in #eng-platform-action-items. :thumbsup:
